name: West Holtburg Outpost
title: West Holtburg Outpost
summary: Twin of South Holtburg Outpost, 1.1 km west of Holtburg: an old starter outpost never attacked by Martine (acpedia: Wantorth the Shopkeeper, Sentry, chest, Life Stone, well). It sits at the foot of a wooded hill (z 46) with the river marsh to the east: a two-storey shop, a brass-lantern hall with a wooden deck, a cottage, the Life Stone and well, and up the slope a green-lit tapered-roof Empyrean hall (top z 76.9) and a 31 m spire tower (top z 106.8).

criticRemovedShots.standingOrder: Look down from above the eastern meadow onto the outpost's shop, Life Stone and well with the Empyrean towers climbing the wooded hill behind, the morning sun at the lens's back; ease 2 m closer.
criticRemovedShots.notes: High angle (34 deg) from 62 m east over the meadow, easing 2 m closer: the shop, the Life Stone with its sign and well, the brass-lantern hall and the cottage below, the green-lit tapered Empyrean hall and the 31 m spire tower climbing the wooded hill behind. Morning sun (0.36) from the east behind the lens. Twin of South Holtburg Outpost, so it gets the opposite (downward, east-facing) treatment.
